description: Fuzzy-match a Quebec city or region name and return its slug, the city_slug that get_city_prices and get_fill_up_verdict take. It matches city and region names only: it does not find gas stations, brands, street addresses, postal codes or landmarks, and returns no coordinates and no prices. Places outside Quebec have no data, so do not search for them. Region results (e.g. Laurentides) are not accepted by the price tools; pick a city. Skip this call when the slug is obvious: lowercase, accents dropped, spaces as hyphens, Saint/Sainte spelled out (Trois-Rivières = trois-rivieres, Québec City = quebec).

query.description: City or region name, e.g. "Sherbrooke", "St-Jérôme" or "Gaspésie". Not a station, brand, address or postal code.

name: search_locations
title: Look up a Quebec city slug
